info.title: AI Study Workspace API
info.description: Authenticated study workspace API: accounts, workspaces, uploaded materials, processing status, Markdown guides, quizzes, graded attempts and progress. Sign in or register to obtain an access token. Background text extraction runs when TIKA_URL is configured. Content-creation endpoints persist supplied content.
